(Amendment) Act 2025
Constitution of the Republic of Singapore
(Amendment) Act 2025 (Commencement) Notification 2026
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 1 of the Constitution of the Republic of Singapore (Amendment) Act 2025, the President makes the following Notification:
